description:
Activate the land's cycling ability by paying {1} and discarding it.
When you cycle the land, Escape Protocol and Bone Miser's second ability trigger.
Resolve Bone Miser's ability, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability, paying {1} to blink Pothole Mole.
When Pothole Mole enters, it triggers, milling three cards and returning the cycled land from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, drawing a card.
